1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment is assembled in vivo from a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that catalyzes a reaction distinct from propanediol utilization.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 2 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes, wherein at least one of the targeted enzymes is not involved in propanediol utilization.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide, wherein the Eut polypeptide is distinct from those described in Parsons et al.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 5 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides, wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides are derived from at least two different bacterial species.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag that is distinct from those described in Kerfeld et al.

9. (Currently Amended) The method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide, wherein the method is used for producing a product that is distinct from propanediol.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium that is not E. coli.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae that is not C. freundii.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast that is distinct from Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9 wherein the host cell comprises an alga that is distinct from those described in Kerfeld et al.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate that is distinct from propanediol.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments, wherein the isolation method is distinct from that described in Parsons et al.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprises an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

17. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments, wherein the compartments are distinct from those described in Parsons et al.
